about.title: About K-Drift
about.lead: Life in Korea, in your language.
about.p1: K-Drift is a multilingual living-info platform for foreigners in Korea. We deliver the essentials — visa, healthcare, housing, work, education — in Vietnamese, English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese, in a way you can trust.
about.p2: Over 90% of life information in Korea is available only in Korean. Drawing on seven years of making content about life in Korea, we re-explain complex administrative information at a level that makes sense for foreigners.
about.p3: We start with a newsletter and grow, together with you, into a trustworthy living-info portal.

footer.tagline: Life in Korea, in your language.

trustBar.label: We only cover announcements from official sources

howItWorks.title: How we make it
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to deliver only information you can trust

step1.title: Collect official announcements
step1.desc: Every week we gather updates from official government channels like the Ministry of Justice and Ministry of Employment and Labor.

step2.title: Summarize and review
step2.desc: AI drafts the summary, and our editors verify every item before it is published.

step3.title: In your language
step3.desc: Translated into Vietnamese, English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese — delivered to your inbox once a week.

tests.title: Two quick tests
tests.subtitle: One on the information you need to live in Korea, one a light check of Korean vocabulary. Both free, and every question comes with an explanation.

vocab.title: TOPIK Vocabulary Test
vocab.subtitle: Levels 1 to 6 — twelve words to gauge your vocabulary
vocab.disclaimer: TOPIK does not publish an official word list. The levels in this test are a reference, based on the graded vocabulary of the National Institute of Korean Language’s Korean Standard Curriculum — they are not an actual TOPIK score.

start.subtitle: You start at level 1 and climb to level 6 — two words per level, twelve in all.
start.h1: You move up level by level, starting easy
start.h2: Pick an answer and an example sentence appears right away
start.h3: At the end you see exactly which level you stalled at

result.breakdownHint: Seeing where you stalled tells you what to study next.
